scope: Passenger railway station inventory used by TrainGuessr Austria

datasets.name: ÖBB GeoNetz
datasets.role: Stable base catalogue and EVA/IFOPT crosswalk
included: EVA_NR identifiers already accepted by the SCOTTY station-board endpoint
IFOPT identifiers for direct matching to the national MVO inventory
not_included: A complete inventory of stations on independently owned Austrian railway infrastructure

datasets.name: MVO Österreichweite Haltestellen
included: Stops served during the timetable year from all Austrian transport associations and ÖBB
Conventional railway and S-Bahn stops selected from the documented transport-mode bitfield
not_included_by_train_guessr: cable/funicular/rack-rail category unless it is also flagged as railway or S-Bahn
notes: MVO stop-centre coordinates are representative points, not necessarily the served platform coordinates.
A candidate absent from GeoNetz is added only after a unique SCOTTY EVA match by name and coordinates.
The MVO catalogue is multimodal; TrainGuessr deliberately accepts only stops whose aggregate mode bitfield contains Eisenbahn or S-Bahn.
Light-rail/tram-only stops are deliberately outside this automatic migration even when they are rail-borne services; they require a separate scope decision.
The live WFS is requested in EPSG:4326 so generated TrainGuessr coordinates are WGS84 regardless of the service native CRS.
Offline ZIP/CSV input is accepted only when its hst_x/hst_y coordinates are WGS84; otherwise the generator fails instead of guessing a CRS.

datasets.name: ÖBB SCOTTY
datasets.role: Runtime timetable source and identifier validation
included: Timetables from Austrian public-transport operators represented in SCOTTY
Realtime data where supplied by the underlying operator
not_guaranteed: Realtime information for every third-party operator
Perfect completeness when an external operator has not supplied data

migration_policy: Keep every existing GeoNetz node and EVA ID unchanged.
Match MVO to GeoNetz by stable IFOPT before doing any name matching.
Use only MVO railway/S-Bahn mode bits for automatic additions.
Resolve each new stop to a unique SCOTTY EVA ID using station name and coordinates.
Reject ambiguous or distant resolutions instead of guessing.
Treat a temporary SCOTTY lookup failure as an unresolved candidate for this rebuild; do not cache the failure or abort the complete migration.

existing_catalogue.result: GeoNetz-only rebuild reproduces all existing TrainGuessr Austria records exactly

findings.full_mvo_migration_count: generated at rebuild time; not hard-coded because MVO is updated daily
